head_commit.message:
Clarify `codex exec` approval help (#16888)

Addresses #13614

Problem: `codex exec --help` implied that `--full-auto` also changed
exec approval mode, even though non-interactive exec stays headless and
does not support interactive approval prompts.

Solution: clarify the `--full-auto` help text so it only describes the
sandbox behavior it actually enables for `codex exec`.

head_commit.message:
Clarify `codex exec` approval help (#16888)

Addresses #13614

Problem: `codex exec --help` implied that `--full-auto` also changed
exec approval mode, even though non-interactive exec stays headless and
does not support interactive approval prompts.

Solution: clarify the `--full-auto` help text so it only describes the
sandbox behavior it actually enables for `codex exec`.

head_commit.message:
Fix TUI feedback upload panic

Route blocking feedback uploads through block_in_place or a scoped OS thread so submitting /feedback does not drop a runtime inside an async context.

workflow_runs.display_title: Zoom breaks controls

head_commit.message:
Clarify `codex exec` approval help (#16888)

Addresses #13614

Problem: `codex exec --help` implied that `--full-auto` also changed
exec approval mode, even though non-interactive exec stays headless and
does not support interactive approval prompts.

Solution: clarify the `--full-auto` help text so it only describes the
sandbox behavior it actually enables for `codex exec`.
